IDENT.title: Cooperative Product Agents to Improve Manufacturing System Flexibility: A Model-Based Decision Framework

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: A product agent (PA) makes decisions for a single part in the manufacturing system; a resource agent is a high-level controller for a resource (cites [5]).
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: A product agent (PA) makes decisions for a single part in the manufacturing system [5].

A_DEFINITION__definition_source.evidence_quote: A product agent (PA) makes decisions for a single part in the manufacturing system [5].

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: PAs that use the proposed direct and active cooperation approach are denoted as direct, active cooperation product agents

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: A resource agent (RA) is a high-level controller for a resource (e.g. robot, machine) on the shop ﬂoor and a product agent (PA) makes decisions for a single part

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: DA-PA’s knowledge base (i.e., the goals, environment model, and decision making model).

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: AEM is an extension of the PTA modeling formalism presented in Section II-D.

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: A custom implementation of the z3 SMT solver was used to encode soft constraints and ﬁnd paths in the DA-PA’s decision making model.

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_scalability_dis.evidence_quote: The computation time remains well below 30 seconds for more than 105 constraints.

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_communication_manage.evidence_quote: While the communication and messaging protocols are out of scope of this paper

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: The Repast Simphony agent-based simulation platform [65] was used to test and analyze the behavior of a DA-PA

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: a direct, actively cooperative product agent (DA-PA) is provided a process plan, exit plan, performance weights, and the priority

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: Goals given at initialization; tracks completed physical properties of the part.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: the DAPA keeps track of the completed physical properties and can identify the next unﬁnished physical property when required.

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: The PAs build the FSM by exploring the manufacturing system through queries to the RAs in the system

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: each PA builds and uses a ﬁnite state machine (FSM) model of a local neighborhood of the manufacturing system

C_MEMORY__memory_persists_across_episode.evidence_quote: New parts entering the system start at buffer 1 (B1) and, once the part enters the system, a new DAPA is initialized.

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: The DA-PA updates its environment model as other agents (RAs and PAs) provide the capabilities and scheduling constraints

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote: to enable the proposed cooperation framework, the DA-PA must keep track of the agents associated with the components in the environment model.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: The communication framework native to Repast Simphony was used to encode messages and enable cooperation between agents.

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The DA-PA sends a violation request to each of the agents in the set Agents, where each agent in this set is either a PA or an RA.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: we refer to direct cooperation between two agents as the utilization of a one-to-one communication link between the agents

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_cost_analyzed.evidence_quote: At these scales, both communication and physical bottlenecks may be more pronounced than the computational bottleneck

E_LEARNING__learning_present.evidence_quote: Currently, the cost of constraint violations is determined using feedback from an operator or a subject matter expert.

E_LEARNING__learning_type.evidence_quote: The DA-PA builds the environment model by requesting capabilities from the RAs in the system

E_LEARNING__explores_beyond_predefined_e.evidence_quote: These updates represent changes in the manufacturing environment, e.g. new resources, updated scheduling constraints

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: Two simulation case studies showcase how direct and active cooperation can be used

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: the DA-PAs that were able to cooperate reduced the ﬂow time in the manufacturing system by 8.5%.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__baseline_compared_.evidence_quote: Order B DA-PAs that did not cooperate had a ﬂow time of 1354 ticks.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote: if a resource goes down in the system, a resource takes longer to perform a requested task, or a new resource is added to the system

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: This simulated system contains 20 manufacturing stations that perform different manufacturing operations

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: A simulation of a semiconductor manufacturing facility was used to study the behavior of direct and active cooperation

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: The proposed cooperation framework extended the simulation of the model-based PAs described in [13].

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Extends FSM-based model to priced timed automata with soft constraints/slack variables, enabling direct active PA-PA negotiation of constraint violations, priorities and SMT-based cost-optimal path planning.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: Current model-based PAs do not capture the negotiable actions, i.e. soft constraints, in their planning and scheduling models.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Agent association function tracking required for cooperation.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: to enable the proposed cooperation framework, the DA-PA must keep track of the agents associated with the components in the environment model.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__cites_reference_fr.evidence_quote: The proposed cooperation framework extended the simulation of the model-based PAs described in [13].

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: 10 parts, each with their own DA-PA, enter the system with the same priority every 50 ticks.
